book.name: Pilipai
book.title: Pilipai Pol Pilipai nɨbi bɨ kalɨp köp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Mɨd aij gɨmim

Anɨb u, nɨbi bɨ aij yad gau. Mɨlö kub gai i mɨdem, kalöp mɨdmagö lem, am nɨŋnam a gem, gasɨ u nɨŋöl gɨ mɨdpin. Kalöp nɨŋem, ñɨñɨ lem gasɨ halö mɨdpin. Manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkpin anɨbi nɨŋmim, anɨg gɨmim, Bɨ Kub nɨŋ ud pɨdöŋ göl gɨ mɨdaimim.
Yuodia aip Sidiki aip, yad kalöp nɨbi mɨhau hagabin, kale Bɨ Kub u nɨp gasɨ nɨŋbil rö, pen pen hagagmil, jɨm ñöl mɨdaimil.

Pen bɨ yad aip jɨm ñöl wög gɨpul, nöp hagabin, nɨbi anɨb mɨhau kalɨp gɨ ñɨmön, mɨd aij gɨmil. Nöd nɨbi anɨb mɨhau, yad u, Klemen u, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap gau aip jɨm ñun, Krais manö aij nɨpe u nɨbi bɨ gau hag ñɨmɨdun. God hib kale buk pör mɨdep yaŋ rɨkö mɨdöp.
Bɨ Kub nɨp cɨg gɨmim, mɨñ mɨñ göl gɨ mɨdaimim. Kauyaŋ u kalöp hagabin, mɨñ mɨñ göl gɨ mɨdaimim!
Nɨbi bɨ hain aij yabɨƚ mɨdaimim, nɨbi bɨ gau magöŋhalö nɨŋöl. Bɨ Kub söl aunab.
Gasɨ kub nɨŋagmim. God nɨp hag nɨŋöl gɨ, aij a göl gɨ, nan magöŋhalö nɨp sabe göl gɨ gɨmim.
Anɨg gɨpe, Krais Jisas nɨp cɨg aij gɨ mɨdpim u me, God hibur hain hain gasɨ mɨdmagö kale aŋ daŋ lö, kale pɨñɨŋ gɨmim gasɨ iru nɨŋagnabim. Nɨbi bɨ nöp mɨdpun rö, God aigegö göm anɨg göp u nɨŋagpun.
Añ mam bɨ. Yad manö söl hag junɨg gem, kalöp manö ap halö hagnɨg gabin.

content.text: nan nɨhön u nɨbi bɨ nɨŋöm ñɨñɨ lɨbal;
nan nɨhön u nɨbi bɨ nɨŋöm aij a gɨpal;
nan anɨb gau nöp gasɨ nɨŋöl gɨ mɨdaimim.

content: Kalöp aip mɨdem, nan nɨhön gɨnö nɨŋbe u, manö nɨhön hagnö nɨŋbe u, nɨŋbe rö nöp gɨmim. Anɨg geinabim, God kalöp aip mɨdöm, gasɨ mɨdmagö kale abad mɨdö, gasɨ iru nɨŋagnabim.
Pilipai nɨbi bɨ Pol nɨp nan ñeila, mɨñ mɨñ ga

Yad hagnö e, yɨp hauƚ gɨpal a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋnö u pen wasö; yɨp gasɨ nɨŋöl gɨ mɨdaibe pen adan mɨdageia nɨŋöm kale yɨp nan ap yuagpe. Pen mɨñi yubim rö, yɨp gasɨ nɨŋöl gɨ mɨdpim u nɨŋem, Bɨ Kub hon u nɨp mɨñ mɨñ yabɨƚ gabin.
Ñɨn rɨmnap yɨharɨŋ mɨdpin gasɨ u nɨŋem hagagabin; Bɨ Kub yɨp gasɨ ñö uri nɨŋbin, yɨp nɨhön nɨhön gɨnab u, manö mɨdagöp.
Ñɨn rɨmnap nan iru mɨdöp; ñɨn rɨmnap mɨdagöp. Mɨdöp ñɨn gau ñɨŋbin; mɨdagöp ñɨn gau yɨharɨŋ mɨdpin. Göp anɨbu, nan iru mɨdö aka mɨdagö, gasɨ kub nɨŋagpin.
Bɨ Kub yɨp abad mɨdöm kƚö ñöb u me, yɨp nɨhön nɨhön gö a gɨnab u gɨnabin.
Pen yɨp mɨŋör gaia, kale yɨp gasɨ nɨŋmim nan ñɨbim u, aij yabɨƚ gɨpim.

Kale Pilipai nɨbi bɨ nɨŋbim, kale Jisas manö aij nɨpe u nöd api nɨŋbe ñɨn u, yad Masedonia Propins arö gem, God Manö hag ñɨ ajmɨdin, God nɨbi bɨ nɨpe mɨdeila gau rɨmnap yɨp nan ñagla. Kale Pilipai nɨbi bɨ nöp yɨp mani nan gau ñɨmɨdim.
Pen amem daun kub Desalonaika mɨdainö ñɨn u, yad nan ap mɨdageia pen kale yɨp mani nan gau pör ñɨmɨdim.
Pen mani nan gau a gem hagagabin; gasɨ kale ke nɨŋmim, nan haƚöwaƚö ñɨbe, God kalpe mɨñ mɨñ yabɨƚ göm, kale gɨpe u hauƚ gagnab, a gem hagabin.

Nan yube magöŋhalö udpin. Bɨ kale Epaprodaidas nɨp mani nan gau ñɨbe, dapöm yɨp ñö, mɨñi nan iru yabɨƚ mɨdö mɨd aij gɨpin. Yɨp yube anɨbu, God nɨp nan lauöm ñɨlö, haƚɨŋ aij auö nɨp aij gɨmɨdöp rö u gɨpim.
Kale Krais Jisas nɨbi bɨ nɨpe mɨdmim, yɨp nan yubim u, God yad bɨ gep yabɨƚ u kalöp abad mɨdöm, nan nɨhön mɨdagainɨm gau kalöp ñɨnɨm.
Anɨb u, God Bapi hon hib nɨpe pör nöp pör nöp hagno adö arnɨm. Anɨb unbö rö aij.
Manö naböŋ magö rɨmnap

Krais Jisas nɨbi bɨ nɨpe bɨ kub Sisa aip mɨdpal gau, kalöp Krais Jisas nɨbi bɨ nɨpe mɨdpim gau, “Kale mɨdpim?” a gɨpal. Anɨb u me, God nɨbi bɨ nɨpe aui mɨdpun magöŋhalö, kalöp Krais Jisas nɨbi bɨ nɨpe mɨdpim gau magöŋhalö, “Kale mɨdpim?” a gabun.
Bɨ Kub Jisas Krais kalöp magöŋhalö mög nɨŋöm abad mɨdainɨm.
